text: Deadlines can be stressful, but handling them well is a skill anyone can learn. The key is good time management, which means breaking large projects into smaller, daily tasks. You should also practice prioritization: decide which tasks are most important and do those first. A common mistake is trying to do everything at once, so remember scope management—know what you can realistically finish and avoid adding extra work. Finally, never underestimate the power of communication. If you see a problem coming, tell your team or manager early. By being proactive and honest, you can reduce pressure and deliver quality work on time.
